description: SIG-GR @ Ministère du Logement et de l'Aménagement du territoire - Département de l’aménagement du territoire: electricity datasets is a collection of datasets listed in The Luxembourg Data Platform, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by SIG-GR @ Ministère du Logement et de l'Aménagement du territoire - Département de l’aménagement du territoire. Coverage: SIG-GR @ Ministère du Logement et de l'Aménagement du territoire - Département de l’aménagement du territoire. The listing groups 5 datasets under this publisher or service host whose titles are about electricity; the first few are linked and all are named in the audit file. Examples: Charging stations for electric vehicles 2021; Seveso establishments and nuclear power plants 2018; Generation capacity for electricity from renewable energies 2016-2018; DFHI-ISFATES - cross-border study programme: Electrical Engineering - . It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is cc-by. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy network and generation-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-la-plateforme-de-donnees-luxembourgeoise.
